adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the activity table extraction, reconciled all linked DBAASP rows to primary XML/PDF evidence, and downgraded mechanism wording to source-supported non-overclaiming classes. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions for modified-sequence normalization and source wording inconsistencies.

details.paper_xml: Tables 1-3, article metadata, design/synthesis and methods/results sections reopened.
details.paper_pdf: Extracted text checked for sequence, table and mechanism anchors.
details.oa_package: NXML/PDF/images available in local OA package; article XML supplied authoritative table values.
details.supplementary_assets: PPTX slide-export and two HTML/publisher helper files checked; no independent activity/toxicity/database values beyond article tables.
details.merged_database_rows: Linked DBAASP assay, experiment and literature JSONL rows reconciled row by row.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows now map to primary article metadata or source table locators. Duplicate experiment rows that omit antibiotic names were reconciled through their source_record_id-linked assay rows. The absent linked sequence snapshot is preserved as a caution and resolved from primary source identity evidence rather than normalized away.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 naprolyginine MIC/MBC values, Table 2 checkerboard FIC rows with paired MIC columns, and Table 3 hemolysis rows are captured with target, value, unit and source locator fields.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are restricted to source-supported design rationale, phenotype, and checkerboard interaction evidence; no direct molecular mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_final_review: The prior ticket is closed because the local materials support the missing activity rows and database reconciliation; no blocking or major open rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The local database packet contains DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows but no linked_sequence_records rows; primary XML/PDF evidence was therefore used to verify the naprolyginine name/modified sequence identity for the shared sequence_key.
Naprolyginine is source-described as a naproxen-conjugated RBRBR peptide with terminal NH2 in the extracted figure text; the audit does not collapse this to an unmodified peptide sequence.
Local source text has a residue-name wording inconsistency, while method/discussion/figure surfaces support the biphenylalanine-coded RBRBR identity; this is retained as a caution rather than hidden.
One Table 2 FIC value is exactly 0.5 while source star-marking treats it as synergistic; the record preserves both the numeric threshold interpretation and source marker.
Local supplementary surfaces were checked and did not add independent structured activity/toxicity values beyond article tables.
